soundness_flags.label: oeq:null-supported-converse / def:mixture-index-set
soundness_flags.one_line: Theta_n permits q_e,q_tau>0 with zeta_2=q_e^2 and zeta_3=zeta_4=0, but no amplitude law can then have positive second moment and zero fourth moment, so the demanded prior cannot exist for every feasible theta.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article establishes pointwise CATE-estimation minimax results in a Hölder model using localized fuzzy hypotheses and a higher-order local-polynomial estimator; it does not state a constant-CATE homogeneity-testing radius.

source_verification_receipts.version: Review of Economics and Statistics 90(3), 2008 published version
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops nonparametric tests including the no-CATE-heterogeneity null with asymptotic analysis; it does not provide a uniform finite-sample Hölder minimax critical radius.
The published article proposes propensity-score-reweighted multisample U-statistic tests for observational treatment-effect heterogeneity and establishes asymptotic normality.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2410.00985v4; JASA online publication record dated 2 July 2026
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The accessible version studies structured quantitative and qualitative CATE-homogeneity tests with asymptotic type-I, fixed-alternative, and local-limit results; the JASA full text was access-restricted, so this comparison is not used to assert any formula mismatch.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the unrestricted zeta_2,zeta_3,zeta_4 grid with an explicit finite truncated-moment cone, or parameterize an actual bounded finite amplitude distribution and derive its moments before defining Theta_n.
State the likelihood-moment cancellation using that explicit amplitude distribution and prove its order-two cancellation in the rough diagnostic before optimizing the converse envelope.
After matching the optimizations, isolate one rough-nuisance regime with a closed exponent, boundary logarithm, and explicit least-favorable prior alongside the no-penalty corollary.

recommended_next_step: Revise the mixture parameterization so every theta quantified by the converse admits an actual bounded amplitude law; then rerun novelty review on the otherwise field-plus kernel.
